This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is first application filed by applicant/accused under Section 439 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.762/2015, registered at Police Station Ashoka Garden District-Bhopal (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 34 of IPC.
2.

Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant was released on bail and,
thereafter, he absconded from law.
Later on, he was arrested and now he is in jail since 25.07.2023.
It is submitted that applicant has not committed any cheating or forgery.
He was having possession over the original document because of which, he is made accused in the case.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail and it is submitted that applicant has misused the liberty granted to him after being released on bail.
